description: This file defines the IQueueCache interface within the Orleans.Streaming namespace, specifying methods for cache management such as adding messages, purging, retrieving cursors, and checking pressure status.

classes.name: IQueueCache
classes.description: Interface for a queue cache that manages message storage, retrieval, and cache pressure status within Orleans streaming.

methods.name: AddToCache
methods.description: Adds a list of message batches to the cache.

methods.name: TryPurgeFromCache
methods.description: Attempts to purge purgable items from the cache, returning true if successful.

methods.name: GetCacheCursor
methods.description: Retrieves a cursor to iterate over cached messages starting at a specific stream and token.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Checks if the cache is under pressure.
